key.name: cursor-size
key.description: Animated cursor height on the original 2 to 10 scale.

key.name: animation-duration-ms
key.description: Time in milliseconds for cursor show and hide animations.

key.name: visible-duration-ms
key.description: Time in milliseconds to keep the cursor visible after shaking stops.

key.name: hide-system-cursor
key.description: Hide the normal pointer while the animated cursor is visible.

key.name: shake-enabled
key.description: Reveal the cursor after a fast back-and-forth mouse movement.

key.name: keyboard-enabled
key.description: Reveal the cursor using a shortcut or double Control press.

key.name: activation-mode
key.description: Hold shows the cursor while active; toggle changes it on each activation.

key.name: activation-method
key.description: Use a regular shortcut or a double press of a Control key.

key.name: require-super
key.description: Require Super to be held during double Control activation.

key.name: hotkey-modifiers
key.description: Canonical modifier names joined by plus signs.

key.name: hotkey-key
key.description: Optional A-Z, 0-9, F1-F12, Space, or Escape shortcut key.

key.name: laser-active
key.description: Retained for compatibility with an already-loaded older extension module.

key.name: laser-enabled
key.description: Allow the configured shortcut to activate the laser pointer.

key.name: laser-activation-mode
key.description: Hold activates while the shortcut is pressed; toggle changes state per press.

key.name: laser-hotkey-modifiers
key.description: Canonical modifier names joined by plus signs.

key.name: laser-hotkey-key
key.description: Optional A-Z, 0-9, F1-F12, or Space shortcut key.

key.name: shake-window-ms
key.description: Recent movement window used for shake detection in milliseconds.

key.name: shake-minimum-speed
key.description: Average pointer speed required for a shake in logical pixels per millisecond.

key.name: shake-minimum-turns
key.description: Number of sharp direction reversals required for a shake.
